data_origin: independent generic mathematical definitions in source; no research data
conventions: All axes are dimensionless. The two synthetic branches are 1.2 ± sqrt((0.28t)²+0.07²). Q and S3 are independent illustrative channels, not inferred from the eigenvalues. Five Gaussian slices are sampled at s=0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1; there is no dense volume or interpolation between slices. Color on slices is amplitude in [0,1]. Maxima are discrete sample maxima, not mode identities. Workflow surface payloads are y-first and are transposed once by the adapter into foundation x-first specs.
